image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a male mallard duck (drake) resting on what appears to be dry leaves or wood debris. The duck features a glossy iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, a chestnut-brown breast, and a greyish body. Its bill is bright yellow with a black tip and nostrils. The background consists of blurred green foliage and brown earth tones.

The coloration is predominantly yellow transitioning to a black tip, which fits the 'yellow-green' description for many drake species (specifically Mallards often have yellow bills in certain lighting/seasons or similar species). It is structurally correct.
The visible eye is dark brown/black, consistent with the taxonomy.
